final: WITH category_totals AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total_difference FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_difference) AS avg_difference FROM category_totals) SELECT c.category, c.avg_remaining, c.total_difference, c.total_difference - o.avg_difference FROM category_totals AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_difference IS NOT NULL AND c.total_difference > o.avg_difference
